scientific.integrity: The proof is analytic. The bundled code checks only finite algebraic identities and a representative matrix; it is not used to infer the asymptotic theorem.
limitations: Trivariate only; exactly one zero correlation and two strictly negative correlations.
Fixed correlation matrix; no uniform transition when correlations approach zero.
Reciprocal/harmonic-mean score only; no positive-Half-Cauchy theorem.

title: A mixed zero–negative Gaussian edge law for reciprocal p-value aggregation
